subject: Workplace Skills
title: Values Drive Satisfaction
description: A 60-second lesson on Values Drive Satisfaction.

hook.text: He took a high-paying job that clashed with his values. Within a year, the money couldn't compensate for the misery.

buildup.text: Job satisfaction research consistently shows that values alignment predicts happiness more than salary does.

discovery.text: Identify your top five values: autonomy, impact, creativity, stability, learning. Then check if your job delivers them.

twist.text: Values shift over time. What mattered at 25 — adventure, growth — may differ at 40 — stability, mentoring.

climax.text: Revisit your values annually. Align career moves to current values, not outdated ones from a decade ago.

punchline.text: Know your values today. Align your career to them now.

quiz.question: What predicts job satisfaction more than salary?
options: Alignment between the role and your personal values
The number of perks and benefits offered
